claim.en: Sigstore is an open source project for signing and verifying artifacts with signing events recorded in a public log; Fulcio issues short-lived certificates, Rekor is a transparency log and keyless signing discards the key pair after signing.

entries.validation: page opened; section 2.1 hash definitions; the RFC is obsoleted by RFC 9162

claim.es: El RFC 6962 define el hash de árbol de Merkle con hoja SHA-256(0x00 || dato) y nodo SHA-256(0x01 || izquierda || derecha), partiendo en la mayor potencia de dos menor que n, con pruebas de inclusión y consistencia; está obsoleto por el RFC 9162.
claim.en: RFC 6962 defines the Merkle tree hash with leaf SHA-256(0x00 || data) and node SHA-256(0x01 || left || right), splitting at the largest power of two smaller than n, with inclusion and consistency proofs; it is obsoleted by RFC 9162.

claim.en: The Go blog describes the checksum database as built on a transparent log (Merkle tree) of hashes backed by Trillian, with inclusion and consistency checks by the go command.

claim.en: The Objective-See page describes LuLu as a free, open-source firewall that blocks unknown outgoing connections, and mentions that some traffic may not go through Network Extensions (such as LuLu).

entries.validation: Files read at commit; python3 -m unittest tests.test_licensing ran 4 tests OK. policy.json lists Neo23x0/signature-base (marker 'Detection Rule License', DRL-1.1, allowed-with-attribution) and Yara-Rules/rules (GPL-2.0, allowed-with-license-notice); verdict() fails on a mismatch with what GitHub reports or the LICENSE text. The statement that redistribution conditions are pending legal review and that no general LICENSE file exists is the owner decision recorded for this wiki; the repository root has no LICENSE file.

claim.es: Las reglas vienen de dos fuentes de terceros con sus propias licencias y el proyecto no reclama derechos de autor sobre ellas; scripts/licensing.py compara la licencia esperada con la real y un desajuste deja la fuente en cuarentena. Es una comprobación de coherencia: las condiciones de redistribución están pendientes de revisión legal.
claim.en: The rules come from two third-party sources under their own licenses and the project claims no copyright over them; scripts/licensing.py compares the expected license with the actual one and a mismatch quarantines the source. It is a consistency check: the redistribution conditions are pending legal review.

entries.validation: files read at commit: job macos needs review and runs if publishable == 'true' and changed != 'false'; job request-publish needs [review, macos] and runs only if publishable == 'true', changed == 'true' and needs.macos.result == 'success'; job app-compat runs after macos and request-publish does not list it in needs; publish.yml re-runs rulecheck and checks set_root, dynamic verdict and canaries before signing

claim.es: Una release se solicita solo si la revisión diaria declara el conjunto publicable y cambiado y el trabajo de medición en macOS termina bien; app-compat informa pero no condiciona; publish.yml vuelve a verificar el conjunto antes de firmar.
claim.en: A release is requested only if the daily review declares the set publishable and changed and the macOS measurement job succeeds; app-compat reports but does not gate; publish.yml re-verifies the set before signing.
